info.title: Portland Low departure
instructions: Climb on runway heading to 500' MSL at 200 KIAS
RWY 18: turn left HDG 025°; at 5 DME, turn left HDG 320°
Then fly direct to PT Silver · maintain 500' MSL and 200 KIAS until clear of Class D (4.3 NM), then 240 KIAS
When instructed by Tower, switch to Corpus Departure · UHF CH 8 and state VFR intentions
Check in: ‘Corpus Departure, <callsign>, 500 feet off Navy Corpus, Portland Low followed by <VFR intentions>’
